name: huffman_encode
role: append the Huffman code of every source byte to a BytesMut, pad the last byte with ones

name: encode_str
role: length-prefixed Huffman string literal: 0x80|len, or 0xff plus a 7-bit continuation varint

name: encode_literal_name_index
role: literal header field with an indexed name: 4-bit prefix index then encode_str of the value
